participation.context: Read the page, and wrote nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You let the open chronicle stand. You did not take a line down from it, and you did not start a page of your own.

title: Looked at the king in the chronicle

participation.context: Read the two words, and wrote none.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the two words and did not add the answer they stand for.

title: Looked at the two words on the tables
